propositions: Gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml that run repo scripts without if-present guards hard-fail when those scripts are absent from the checked-out patchset tree
Gerrit's Verified lane uses the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the change's tree, causing steps added on main to run against changes predating the script file
Nine unguarded steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job exit with errno 2 (file not found) when their script is missing, indistinguishable from real gate violations
Each unguarded gate step must be wrapped with an if-present guard that skips with a log line when the script is absent, matching the pattern established in bug 7e90-233b-3ee9-4f14
A structural linter check is needed to prevent future gate steps from being added without the if-present guard, decoupling enforcement from author recollection of the ee2a convention
